subject: GENERATE statement
notes: kb/Work PB326, landed. 'The report … shall be in the active state. If it is not, the EC-REPORT-INACTIVE exception condition is set to exist, if it is enabled.' CobolReport.Generate calls ExceptionState.ReportInactiveError and returns, adding no line. The golden GENERATEs after a successful TERMINATE and sees the condition handled with no further detail line in the report file. The rule's own 'if it is enabled' is the >>TURN gate, which is what the raise helper implements. kb/Work PB688 (2026-09-05): the golden moved from tests/conformance/2002 to tests/conformance/2023 - it observes the report by re-reading the report file through ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL, which is a COBOL-2023 introduction (12.4.5.10.3 GR2; the Foreword's main-changes list over ISO/IEC 1989:2014), so the program is not expressible at 2002. The RULE's editions are unchanged.
